prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished transparent top-down 2D game character sprite for a microscopic cell strategy game. Primary request: redesign a RED BLOOD CELL as a slightly cute, beautiful, rounded living cell, with NO limbs, which floats and turns by rotating its entire body. Subject: one soft coral-red / strawberry-red biconcave disc, distinctly a red blood cell, shallow depressed center (not a hole), pillowy thick rounded rim, smooth satin jelly membrane with restrained broad highlights. Add two small dark friendly eyes and a tiny subtle smile on the upper surface, expressive but not babyish. Style: polished hand-painted 3D-like casual game asset, simple clean silhouette and appealing readable large shapes, tasteful pastel color, no busy internal organelles, no tiny sparkles. Camera: strictly overhead orthographic top-down, disc lies flat, no horizon, no side view. Composition: exactly one character centered in a square transparent canvas, symmetric center of mass; outer body fits within a circle whose diameter is 80% of canvas width, generous transparent margin on all four sides; no crop. Keep the membrane edge crisp and clearly defined. Lighting: soft top-left highlights within the body only, subtle dimensional shading. Constraints: actual transparent alpha background, no cast ground shadow, no outer glow halo, no text, no labels, no watermark, no equipment, no arms, no hands, no legs, no feet, no fins, no tail, no antennae, no tentacles, no spiky silhouette. The red disc must be immediately recognizable. It will be rotated in game, so include no directional ground cue.
